options.name: Horseshoe Bend Air Tour
options.detail: Helicopter tour over Lake Powell, Glen Canyon Dam, and Horseshoe Bend with aerial views and photo opportunities.

services.name: Horseshoe Bend
services.desc: Avoid the crowds and get your camera ready to capture the serene beauty of Lake Powell, the engineering marvel of Glen Canyon Dam, and the curious curve of Horseshoe Bend with this one-of-a-kind helicopter tour. Its fast, its easy and its unforgettable. Helicopter Tours are one of the best ways to capture the scenic beauty of this rugged landscape they allow you cover large amounts of ground quickly and the large windows allow you to get those perfect shots. Horseshoe Bend is the intimate Grand Canyon experience (although technically located in Glen Canyon.) It overlooks one of the most spectacular views on the Colorado River, 4 miles south of the Glen Canyon Dam, and 7 miles north of mile

blurb: Guests explore Antelope Canyon by boat on Lake Powell, enjoying close views of canyon walls and rock formations. The tour includes panoramic views, photo assistance, and swimming in warmer months. Other offerings include helicopter tours to Horseshoe Bend and Tower Butte with scenic views.
extraNote: Wahweap Public Dock below Wahweap Public Launch Ramp; park at Lake Powell Resort single-car lots near the top of the launch ramp, not at Wahweap Marina.
